result.title: Image Deblending with Diffusion Models
result.comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. 22 pages, 10 figures. Code: https://github.com/DanBotchan/image-deblending-diffusion
result.summary: Image deblending is the task of decomposing a composite image back into its source images, which is an ill-posed problem, as a single blended image can be decomposed into multiple plausible source layers. While diffusion models are often used to solve inverse problems, they typically address single-output reconstruction problems. In this work, we formulate deblending as a joint inverse problem, employing diffusion posterior sampling to simultaneously reconstruct two source images, demonstrating that a single diffusion prior is expressive enough to disentangle two full images at once rather than just one. Drawing inspiration from human perception, where semantic understanding helps disentangle visual inconsistencies, we propose a training-free framework that leverages text prompts to constrain this solution space. We address the blind deblending task through a two-stage architecture: text-guided latent diffusion performs semantic separation using prompts as high-level cues, followed by a pixel-space refinement to recover fine details. Stochastic sampling produces multiple plausible decompositions that can be ranked without ground truth. Extensive experiments show that our training-free method achieves state-of-the-art results on unseen domains and extends to spatially-varying alpha maps, while remaining competitive with supervised baselines on standard scalar blending benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文把图像去混合表述为联合逆问题，用扩散后验采样同时重建两张源图像，并提出免训练的两阶段框架：先以文本提示引导的 latent diffusion 做语义分离，再在像素空间细化细节。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「随机采样出多种可行分解并在无真值条件下排序」的做法，可能与 LVR 中多 latent 假设的枚举与评分、用语义线索压缩解空间的可核查线索相关，但该工作仍属图像分解而非推理状态建模，联系较远。
